verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents machine-learning risk scores on every authorization (fraud risk, dispute risk, card-testing detection) and real-time approve/decline via a synchronous webhook. It also supports replacing lost or stolen cards. However, the evidence never shows suspicious-activity alerts and never explicitly describes freezing or blocking a compromised card. The risk-score claim appears only on the Issuing-for-agents page. Missing for 10: suspicious-activity alerting, explicit card block/freeze tooling, network fraud scores, confirmation that risk scores apply beyond the agents use case, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform fights fraud on my issued cards — network fraud scores or its own models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, and tooling to block and reissue compromised cards

citations.quote: Get machine learning-generated risk scores on every authorization, including fraud risk, merchant dispute risk, and card testing detections.
Using the synchronous webhook, you can approve or decline authorization requests in real time.
Replace cards that are expired, damaged, lost, or stolen.
